charts.title: TOI-700 b: orbits around TOI-700
charts.description: The orbits of TOI-700's planets in this map from above, to scale, with TOI-700 b highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Pass et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172..175P), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname PASS_ET_AL_2026): P 9.97722 d

charts.title: TOI-700 b: its transit
charts.description: TOI-700 b crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (95, 96, 97) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 150428135, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 10 minutes later to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 12 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 9-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 10 min late; 9-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 4 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
